name: Inform and enable logs in ` shoptet.dev.deprecated`

### Description

# Context

In [https://github.com/shoptet/cms4/pull/10796](https://github.com/shoptet/cms4/pull/10796) we added a deprecation function {{ shoptet.dev.deprecated}}. We want to inform our partners first. 

# Task

- Put the note about the deprecation notice function in the FE News after a few days enable the `console.log` in `shoptet.dev.deprecated`. 
- Think about the message that appears in the console. Maybe there can be something like 'Contact your Partner to fix this issue'.
